caption: Sovereign Bank v. REMI Capital, Inc.
citation_line: Sovereign Bank v. REMI Capital, Inc., No. 21-2289 (3d Cir. Sept. 15, 2022)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Sheridan discharged a consent judgment after concluding that the obligor had satisfied the judgment as written and that the court could not add a contractual post-judgment interest term omitted from the judgment.
qualification_rationale: The precedential decision gives practical guidance on drafting settlements and consent judgments and on the limits of a district court’s authority to enforce obligations that the parties did not clearly incorporate into the judgment.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit affirmed in a precedential opinion, emphasizing that parties must state their bargain with precision and that a court may not divine and enforce an otherwise silent term.
